3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

78142-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78142-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78142-progress.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

98189-accept.name: Karl Boran
98189-accept.text:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
98189-accept.title: Return the Statuette

98189-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-complete.text: You managed to get it back from those monsters! There aren't too many artifacts of the late king left now.
98189-complete.title: Return the Statuette

98189-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98189-progress.text: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189-progress.title: Return the Statuette

98190-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98190-accept.text:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, lass. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190-accept.title: A Friend of the Family

98190-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-complete.text: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
98190-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98190-progress.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-progress.text: Let us speak, $c. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98191-accept.text:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191-accept.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-complete.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-complete.text:
By the Light... it looks just like his boy...

<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>

This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.

It is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.

Thank you, $c. Light bless you.
98191-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-progress.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-progress.text: Light be with you, $c. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98197-complete.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-complete.text:
Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.

Thank you, $c. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!
98197-complete.title: Spoils of War

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War

98208-accept.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-accept.text:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208-accept.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98219-accept.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98219-accept.text:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $N.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219-accept.title: The Shamed Lieutenant

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force
